thesis.trigger: Nvidia keeps funding and supplying neoclouds
thesis.breaks_if: Nvidia's results or call (Nov 17) walk back customer investments, backstops such as CoreWeave's $6.3B, or neocloud supply allocation
thesis.evidence: Nvidia says commitments proceed 'without interruption'. But reports (The Information, Reuters) say interim CEO Kress opposed Huang's largest OpenAI backstop; neocloud backstops total about $36B off balance sheet. Results Nov 17.

thesis.trigger: Nebius's own 2027 sites come online on time
thesis.breaks_if: Another capacity shift, a site delay, or a 2027 revenue guide below $12B
thesis.evidence: 2026 revenue cut to $3.0-3.2B on colocation delays (Vineland power). Management says most 2027 capacity is on owned sites.

thesis.trigger: New Nebius deals keep coming with prepayments
thesis.breaks_if: Deferred revenue stops rising quarter on quarter, or Nebius raises new converts or equity between earnings because prepayments fall short
thesis.evidence: Q3: over 90% of contract value prepaid, covering over 100% of Q3 capex; deferred revenue $9.4B (from $1.6B at end-2025).

thesis.trigger: Blackwell rental demand stays ahead of supply
thesis.breaks_if: Nebius B300 spot stays below 50% of on-demand for 7 days in a row
thesis.evidence: Spot 55% of on-demand on 2026-11-23; below 50% on 0 of the last 7 days.

narratives.confirmed_if: Hyperscaler capex falls quarter on quarter; GPU spot and traded prices fall for a full quarter; new neocloud deals sign below $20M per MW; the high-yield spread widens sharply
narratives.breaks_if: Capex keeps rising year on year; new deals keep pricing at or above $25M per MW with prepayments; spot stays tight
narratives.note: Debt is real; demand and prices are still rising

narratives.confirmed_if: Nvidia's filings show its neocloud backstops and stakes growing as a share of their funding; a neocloud's build stalls when Nvidia support is cut
narratives.breaks_if: New neocloud capex is funded mostly by customer prepayments and outside debt; Nvidia trims backstops and builds continue
narratives.note: Fits CoreWeave; Nebius's Q3 build was customer-prepaid

narratives.confirmed_if: Nvidia cancels or shrinks customer commitments or backstops; supply or roadmap slips; more senior departures; the export probe hits sales
narratives.breaks_if: Kress reaffirms commitments and backstops on Nov 17; the Q4 guide holds; no customer cancels
narratives.note: No commitment cancelled; a financing shock, not a demand shock

narratives.confirmed_if: A neocloud pulls or fails a raise; refinancing comes at sharply wider spreads; a build stops for lack of money (Applied Digital's 800 MW, Nscale's West Virginia site)
narratives.breaks_if: Nebius and CoreWeave close new debt at steady spreads; Applied Digital finances its 800 MW; prepayments plus asset-backed loans keep covering 75% or more of capex
narratives.note: Funding is dearer and shorter, not shut, except for the weakest

narratives.confirmed_if: The $7B ARR slips past February 2027; Q4 revenue lands below the $3.0B guide floor; more sites slip
narratives.breaks_if: $7B monthly ARR by February 2027; owned 2027 sites come online on time; Q4 meets guidance
narratives.note: Missed on timing; beat on revenue, margin and pricing

narratives.confirmed_if: B300 and B200 spot back at 60% or more of on-demand for weeks; traded prices keep rising; providers raise list prices again
narratives.breaks_if: Blackwell spot stays below 50% of on-demand (our thesis trigger); list prices are cut; short-dated $/MW falls
narratives.note: True for short-dated H100; Blackwell spot loosened in November

narratives.confirmed_if: A major lab or neocloud announces a large AMD or custom-chip deployment; AMD raises its data-center guide; Nvidia loses share in its results
narratives.breaks_if: No switching announcements; Nvidia's Q4 guide is strong; AMD's guide is unchanged
narratives.note: One day of price action; no customer switch reported
